spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (चनति चानयति)
To hurt, to injure in any manner, to wound or kill, &c.
2 To believe, to confide.
3 To make a sound.

ind.
A particle affixed to certain words, giving them an indefinite signification, as कदा when, कदाचन some when, at sometime, कः who कञ्चन some one: see चित्.
E.
चन to sound, affix अच्.

n. (-नः)
Food.
E.
च, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and नुट् augment.

m. (-न्दः)
The moon.
E.
चदि to shine, affix अच्: see चन्द्र.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Pleasing, joy-inspiring.
m. (-कः)
1 The moon.
2

Moonlight.
3

A small silvery fish, of a genus allied to the Zeus, (Canda, HAM.)
E.
चदि to shine, वुन् aff.

n. (-ष्पं)
Cloves.
E.
चन्द्रक, and पुष्प flower.

mn. (-नः-नं)
Sandal, (Sirium myrtifolium); it implies either the tree, the wood, or the unctuous preparations of the wood, held in high estimation as perfumes.
n. (-नं)
Red Sandal wood: see रक्रचन्दन.
m. (-नः)
A kind of ape.
f. (-नी)
The name of a river.
E.
चदि to gladden, to delight, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-लः)
The Malaya mountain, part of the southern range of the Ghāts, where Sandal wood is procured.
E.
चन्दन and अचल a hill, the Sandal hill; also similar names, as चन्दनाद्रि, चन्दनपर्वत, &c.

m. (-रः)
1 An elephant.
2 The moon.
E.
चदि to shine, &c. Uṇādi affix किरच्.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 The moon considered as a planet or a deity.
2

Camphor.
3

Water.
4

Gold.
5

A plant, (Crinum): see रोचनी.
6 (In composition) Pre-eminent, (as पुरुषचन्द्र an eminent man, a chief, a moon of men.)
7 The eye in the peacock's tail.
8 One of the eighteen minor Dvīpas or divisions of the known continent.
9 The mark of the soft aspirate.
10 A pearl with a red tinge.
11 Any thing giving pleasure.
f. (-न्द्रा)
1 An awning, a canopy.
2 Small cardamoms: see एला.
E.
चदि to shine, Uṇādi affix रक्.

mfn. (-न्द्रः-न्द्री-न्द्रं)
Lunar, relating to the moon, regulated by it, &c.
m. (-न्द्रः)
1 The Candrakānta or moon-gem.
2 A month, a lunar month.
3 The light fortnight or half month, during which the moon is on the increase.
n. (-न्द्रं)
The Cāndrāyaṇa observance: see चान्द्रायण.
f. (-न्द्री)
Moonlight.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and अण् affix of relation.

m. (-कः)
1 The moon.
2 A ring, a circle, (like the moon.)
3 The eye in a peacock's tail.
4 A finger nail.
5 A fish, (Canda, HAM.)
n. (-कं)
Black pepper.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and कन् affix of resemblance.

n. (-कं)
Fresh ginger.
E.
कन् added the last.

m. (-वान्)
A peacock.
E.
चन्द्रक the mark in his tail, मतुप् aff.

f. (-ला)
1 A digit, or one-sixteenth of the moon's orb; each is personified as a female divinity, and worshipped in some Tāntrika ceremonies.
2 A small drum.
3 A fish commonly called Vacā or Bacā, (Pimelodus vacha, HAM.)
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and कला a digit.

m. (-न्तः)
A fabulous gem, the moon-stone, supposed to be formed of the congelation of the rays of the moon; a kind of crystal may perhaps be meant.
mn. (-न्तः-न्तं)
1

Sandal.
2

The white water lily.
f. (-न्ता)
1

Night.
2

The wife of the moon.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and कान्त splendid or beloved.

m. (-की)
A peacock.
E.
चन्द्रक the eye of the peacock's tail, and इनि poss. aff.

m. (-प्तः)
1 The registrar of YAMA'S court.
2 SANDROKOPTUS king of Pāṭaliputra.

n. (-लं)
The orb or sphere of the moon.
E.
चन्द्र, and गोल a ball.

m. (-स्थः)
A deceased and deified progenitor.
E.
चन्द्रगोल, and स्थ who stays or abides; an inhabitant of the lunar sphere.

f. (-का)
Moonlight.
E.
चन्द्रगोल the lunar orb, and कन् affix; derived from the moon.

mf. (-लः-ला)
A small fish, (Canda, HAM.)
E.
चन्द्र, and चञ्चल trembling, quivering, and glistering like the moon.

plu. m. (-राः)
The twenty-seven lunar mansions, which, in mythology, are so many nymphs, daughters of DAKṢA, and wedded to CANDRA, or the moon.
E.
चन्द्र, and दार a wife.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Like the moon, bright, handsome.
E.
चन्द्र, and निभ what resembles.

f. (-गा-गी)
The name of a river, the Chinab, one of the five streams of the Punjab.
E.
चन्द्रभाग the name of a mountain, part of the Himāla range, where the river is said to have its source, affix of derivation अण्, hence also it may be read चान्द्रभागा-गी.

f. (-गा)
A river, the Chinab: see चन्द्रभागा; also चान्द्रभागी.

m. (-भः)
The eighth^1 Jina or Jaina pontiff.
f. (-भा)
1

Moonlight.
2

A compound of various drugs used in jaundice, piles, &c.
E.
चन्द्र, and प्रभा light.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-णिः)
The Candrakānta or moon-gem: see चन्द्रकान्त.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and मणि a gem.

n. (-लं)
The orb or disc of the moon, the lunar sphere.
E.
चन्द्र, and मण्डल circle.

m. (-माः)
The moon.
E.
चन्द्र camphor, मा to mete or measure, and असि Uṇādi affix; rendering all objects white like camphor.

m. (-लिः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
चन्द्र, and मौलि a crest; this deity being represented with a half moon on his forehead.

f. (-खा)
A digit of the moon.
E.
चन्द्र, and रेखा a line.

m. (-णुः)
A plagiarist, a poetical thief, (काव्यचौर.)
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and रेणु dust.

f. (-खा)
1 A plant, (Serrantula anthelmintica): see सोमराजी.
2 A digit of the moon.
E.
चन्द्र, and लेखा a line or mark.

n. (-कं)
The sphere or heaven of the moon.
E.
चन्द्र, and लोक world.

n. (-हं)
Silver.
E.
चन्द्र, and लौह metal; also चन्द्रलौहकं.

m. (-शः)
The race of the moon, the second great branch of the Kṣatriya or royal dynasties, derived from the moon, through BUDHA his son, and Purūravas his son.
E.
चन्द्र, and वंश race.

m. (-शी)
A member of the lunar dynasty.
E.
चन्द्रवंश, and इनि aff.

f. (-री)
1 A kind of asclepias, (A. acida): see सोमलता.
2 Rue: see ब्राह्मी.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and वल्लरी a creeper.

f. (-ला)
Large cardamoms.
E.
चन्द्र camphor, and वाला a child, a diminutive term in general.

m. (-मः)
A kind of crane.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, (as white,) and विहङ्गम a bird.

n. (-तं)
1 A regal property or virtue.
2 A kind of penance: see चान्द्रायण.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and व्रत religious observance.

Moonlight.
2

An upper room, an apartment on the house top.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and शाला a hall.

f. (-का)
A room on the top of a house.
E.
कन् affixed to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

The name of a mountain; one so called is amongst the hills of Aracan.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and शेखर a crest; whose^1 crest is the moon.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-ज्ञः)
Camphor.
E.
चन्द्र, and संज्ञा a name: having all the synonyms of the moon.

m. (-वः)
Budha, the planet MERCURY.
E.
चन्द्र, and आत्मज son.

f. (-वा)
Small cardamoms.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and सम्भव produced.

n. (-क्यं)
Attainment of the lunar heaven.
E.
चन्द्र, and सालोक्य domicile.

m. (-सः)
1 A scimitar.
2 The sword of RĀVAṆA.
f. (-सा)
Moon plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
n. (-सं)
Silver.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and हास what derides; outvieing the moon in brightness.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Moon-shaped, like the moon, (in roundness, whiteness, &c.)
E.
चन्द्र, and आकृति form.

Moonlight.
2

An awning.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and आतप shining.

n. (-र्द्धं)
A half moon, a crescent.
E.
चन्द्र, and अर्द्ध half.

m. (-डः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and आपीड a chaplet; who has the moon like a chaplet amidst his hair.

m. (-सः)
A false moon, an appearance like the moon.
E.
चन्द्र, and आभास resembling.

Moonlight.
2

A small fish, commonly Cāndā, (Canda of var. species, HAM.)
3 Large cardamoms.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and वुन् aff.

m. (-वः)
The moon-stone.
E.
चन्द्रिका, and द्राव what fuses; liquefying in moonlight.

m. (-यी)
The Cakora or hill partridge.
E.
चन्द्रिका, and पायिन् who drinks.

n. (-जं)
The white lotus.
E.
चन्द्रिका, and अम्बुज a lotus.

m. (-लः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2

A barber.
3 A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)
E.
चन्द्र the moon or weapon, &c. bright as the moon, and इलच् aff.

m. (-यः)
1 An awning, a cloth or sheet spread over the large open courts of Hindu houses, upon festival occasions.
2 Moon-rise.
3 A mercurial preparation used in medicine.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and उदय rising, (of a planet, &c.)

m. (-लः)
Moon-gem: see चन्द्रकान्त.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and उपल a stone.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Made of or derived from Sandal, perfumed with it, &c.
E.
चन्दन, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Lunar, relating or belonging to the moon, &c.
n. (-सं)
The constellation Mṛgaśiras; stars in Orion.
E.
चन्द्रमस् the moon, and अण् affix; the moon being its ruling deity.

m. (-सः)
A lunar month, from new moon to new moon, when it is called Mukhya, and from full moon to full moon, when it is termed Gauna.
E.
चान्द्र lunar, मास month.

m. (-नः)
A name of BUDDHA, regent of Mercury, and son of CANDRA or the moon.
E.
चन्द्रमस the moon, फक् affix; or with फिञ् affix चान्द्रमसायनि.

m. (-णः)
A religious or expiatory observance, regulated by the moon's age; diminishing the daily consumption of food every day, by one mouthful, for the dark half of the month beginning with fifteen at the full moon, until it is reduced to one, at the new moon, and then increasing it in like manner during the fortnight of the moon's increase: there are other forms of this penance.
E.
चन्द्र the moon, and फक् aff.

n. (-तं)
The penance called Cāndrāyaṇa.
E.
चान्द्रायण as before, and व्रत observance.

n. (-नं)
The penance called Cāndrāyaṇa.
E.
चान्द्रायण as before, and विधान rite.
